title: Neon Genesis: Evangelion: Koutetsu no Girlfriend
native_title: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン 鋼鉄のガールフレンド
overview:
A transfer student... wavering emotions... a feeling that something is about to change...

An original story set in Tokyo-3 from the Neon Genesis Evangelion anime. A new girl, Mana Kirishima, transfers into Shinji Ikari's class, and the two quickly grow close - while Asuka begins to wonder what Mana is really after.

Follow the story through animated scenes, moving between locations to trigger new events. The choice you make near the end decides which of several endings you see.

- Two-disc adventure for 1 player
- Memory backup support

転校生…揺れ動く感情…何かが変わる予感…
